prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a single polished mobile-app screen design for approval, not application code.
Create a refined, production-ready RIDER RIDE HISTORY screen for the existing Rakky Ride app. Portrait canvas approximately 1024 x 2048, depicting one complete 390px-wide logical phone screen edge-to-edge. Flat UI screenshot without a phone device frame, hands, perspective, decorations, or presentation-board headings.

Visual direction: white-forward, quiet and compact, consistent with a clean Bolt/Uber-inspired ride app. Forest green #176B17 primary, charcoal #141A14 text, muted gray #586253 secondary text, white surfaces, very pale silver #EEF1EC grouping surfaces, pale mint #EAF5E5 highlights, subtle thin dividers/borders. Rounded corners restrained at 12-16 logical px. Minimal shadow. Typography similar to Inter: compact 15-16 logical px title, 13-14 logical px body, 13 logical px metadata; do NOT make large headings or oversized icons. All utility icons 16-18 logical px, a small standard green sedan symbol around 26px wide. Clear 44px touch targets despite small visible glyphs. Plenty of readable space but no tall empty hero area. No purple/blue palette.

Layout:
1. Compact top safe area with normal status bar. Header with a small back arrow in a light silver circular touch target, title exactly "Ride history". No large subtitle, total-spend dashboard, illustrations, photographs, or maps.
2. A slim pale mint scheduled-rides row with small calendar icon, exact label "Scheduled rides", short secondary line "Upcoming bookings", right-aligned "View" and a tiny chevron.
3. Compact filter pills on one row: "All" selected in forest green with white text, "Completed", "Not completed". Keep them low and proportionate.
4. Date heading "Today · 20 Oct", then TWO compact ride cards. Each card is an elegant clean white surface with a quiet fine border, 12-14px radius, 12px padding. A small sedan icon in a light mint 32px tile at upper left, a compact time beside it, a readable text status pill at upper right. Below, pickup and destination on separate short lines with tiny hollow-circle and pin icons connected subtly. The whole card is tappable with a small right chevron; avoid big buttons in every row.
   First card: time "11:42 AM"; green text status "Completed"; pickup "Allen Avenue, Ikeja"; destination "Ikeja City Mall, Alausa"; footer "Cash · View receipt" left, actual fare "₦3,500" right in compact medium weight.
   Second card: time "10:18 AM"; muted amber text status "No drivers found"; pickup "Lekki Phase 1"; destination "Victoria Island"; footer "View details" left, "Not charged" right. Absolutely no currency amount on this unsuccessful card.
5. Date heading "Yesterday · 19 Oct", then TWO cards following same compact rhythm:
   Third card: time "6:20 PM"; soft red text status "Cancelled"; pickup "Admiralty Way, Lekki"; destination "The Palms, Lekki"; footer "View details" left, "Not charged" right. No fare amount on this cancelled card.
   Fourth card: time "9:15 AM"; green text status "Completed"; pickup "Yaba, Lagos"; destination "Maryland Mall"; footer "Wallet · View receipt" left, fare "₦4,200" right.
6. Bottom safe area only. No invented bottom navigation or promotional banners.

Make all four trips fit comfortably and legibly within the screen, using compact rows and restrained spacing. Status must always be expressed in text as well as color. Small icons must be conventional clean vector-like symbols, not emoji. The focus is very clear route hierarchy and small type, not decorative artwork. Use exact Nigerian naira character ₦, not N or $. All names, routes, dates and fares supplied here are fictional sample UI data. This is a new design: do not use any real user's trip records or private screenshot. Do not add extra copy or text.
